v06-dog-ball.observed_description: Sunny garden lawn in front of a house with blue and yellow flowers: a small black-and-white terrier with tan cheeks, seen in profile from its level, stands on all four legs with a red rubber ball in its mouth, tail behind it. No people, no text.
v06-dog-ball.note: Usable: the dog with its ball reads at every size down to 180 px and inside the centered 4:5 crop (revision 2; revision 1's head-on dog was rejected).
